arrival_ts_header: ARRIVAL zones (owner-approved Raja / Kevin rules, Oct 2026) for the bot's charts and verdict. Canonical
implementation: the Python alert side (tools/...) ports it and must give the same results on the shared fixture
tools/telegram_bot/parity/arrival_fixtures.json (src/core/telegramArrival.test.ts checks this file against it).
Per timeframe, on CLOSED bars (shift convention of zonecore.ts: 0 = phantom bar at the price, 1 = newest closed bar):
lines   zvLines (zvTrend.ts): the two most recent real peaks (down) / valleys (up), wick to wick, re-anchored by
FitAnchor; Confirmed, not TooFlat, not broken by a full closed candle.
zones   zonecore.detect(S, p) - every zone, removed ones included (p = RAJA for stocks, FX_PARAMS for FX).
ARRIVAL a zone z (dir d: +1 demand, -1 supply) whose leg-out crosses the trend line against it and removes >= 1
opposite zone:
1. leg-out bars = z.legBar, then the next newer bars (legBar-1, legBar-2: at most 3 bars in all) while each
closes in direction d (cdir = d) and is not a basing candle (body < 50% of its range); never shift < 1.
2. the line = zvLines on the closed bars OLDER than the leg-out (shifts >= legBar + 1; that series' phantom
price = its newest close): its DOWN line for a demand, its UP line for a supply. None = no arrival.
Shifts of that series map to the full one by + legBar.
3. crossed: the first leg-out bar (oldest first) whose close is beyond the line (demand: C > line; supply:
C < line; line value at full shift j = zvAt(line, j - legBar)). None = no arrival.
4. removed: the detect() zones of the other side with removed = true and removedBar inside the leg-out
bars (legBar >= removedBar >= the newest leg-out bar), in detect order. 0 = no arrival; 2+ = strong.
CURRENT the arrival with the smallest legBar (newest) whose zone is not removed; null when none.
Plan of the current arrival (d = its dir; HTF = the next higher TF's closed bars, LTF = the confirmation TF's):
lineNow  the HTF line against d (demand arrival: the HTF DOWN line; supply: the HTF UP line) - zvLines on the HTF
closed bars with the live price as phantom - its value now (zvAt(line, 0)); null without that line.
ceiling  lineNow when it is beyond price (demand: > price; supply: < price); else null.
weak     every not-removed same-TF zone of the other side not wholly on the arrival's side of price (demand arrival:
supplies with max(prox, dist) > price; supply arrival: demands with min(prox, dist) < price), departure
<= max_zone_age.
Drawn dashed: "weak - no limit" (Raja: after a supply arrival there are no limit buys on that TF).
realign  the weak zone nearest lineNow (gap 0 when the value is inside the zone; ties: nearer price); null
without lineNow.
target   realign, else the weak zone nearest price (gap); targetPx = its proximal; null when no weak zone.
tp       with a ceiling: demand min(targetPx, ceiling), supply max(targetPx, ceiling) (targetPx null: the ceiling);
capped = tp is the ceiling. Without one: the nearest (gap) not-removed HTF zone of the other side wholly
beyond price (demand: min(prox, dist) > price; supply: max(prox, dist) < price), departure <= max_zone_age
(htfZone; its proximal) when it is further than targetPx (or targetPx is null): tp = that, extended = true;
else tp = targetPx.
entry    the arrival zone's proximal; stop its distal.
Confirmation on the LTF (map CONFIRM_TF; only with a realign zone and LTF bars): the LTF arrivals of the other side
(after a supply arrival: LTF demand arrivals) whose zone is not removed, overlaps the realign zone's price range
and whose leg-out bar time >= the HTF arrival's leg-out bar time (times compared as 'YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM'); the
newest (smallest LTF legBar). Plan: entry its proximal, stop its distal, target = the TF's newest real pivot on
the arrival's side (supply arrival: the newest real PEAK's high = the TF's last swing high; demand arrival: the
newest real valley's low); null when none. inArea = price inside the realign zone.
Edge cases (parity): a TF with < 20 closed bars has no reading; detect() runs only when the series (closed bars +
phantom) holds > max_base + 4 bars; a leg-out with < 10 older closed bars has no line; HTF readings need >= 10
closed HTF bars, LTF ones >= 20. Every sort is stable (ties keep detect order: older departure first).
Pure (no Deno, no network).
zvTrend_header: Trendlines for the bot's chart images: the owner's ZoneVision indicator rule (public/tools/RFX_ZoneCore.mqh ZigZag /
LineAt / RemovedAt / Confirmed / TooFlat, cross-checked with public/tools/RamanFX_ZoneVision.pine), with the owner's
two-pivot rule on top. NOT the scanners' rule: tools/stock_scanner/zones.py trendlines() (ported in trendcore.ts for
parity, used by the Raja signals) keeps its anchor search and 'overall' line; only the chart draws these.
Owner: "We draw from real valleys and real peaks. Real valleys are pivot points after which price made a new high;
real peaks are pivot points after which price made a new lower low, on that timeframe." and "We draw a trendline from
the most recent TWO peaks or TWO valleys only."
1. Swing low (FrLow, InpTLSwing = 2): a low <= the 2 older lows and < the 2 newer lows (swing high mirrored), within
the newest min(InpLookback = 200, closed bars - InpTLSwing) bars (MQL: SBars - 20, see zvLines), low / high = the candle's wick (SL / SH = iLow / iHigh).
2. ZigZag: a swing low is a REAL VALLEY when, before any later low goes below it, a later high goes above the most
recent swing high before it (a new higher high). A swing high is a REAL PEAK when, before any later high goes
above it, a later low goes below the most recent swing low before it (a new lower low).
3. Up line = the two most recent real valleys, the newer one higher; down line = the two most recent real peaks, the
newer one lower, through the two wicks; when a candle between them pokes through the line the OLDER anchor moves
to that candle's wick (ZoneVision FitAnchor, tol 0.05 ATR, owner-approved Oct 2026; the overall line / older
anchors are still not used). Dropped (nothing drawn that way) when the pair is in the
wrong order, TooFlat (< 0.015 ATR per bar, or < 1.5 ATR between the anchors; ATR(14) at the newer pivot), not
Confirmed (price never went beyond the extreme between the anchors before a full candle crossed the line) or
removed (RemovedAt: a full closed candle beyond it - an up line with a later high below it).
4. `cuts` = candles between the anchors the final line still cuts by more than 0.05 ATR (0 after FitAnchor).
Index convention as zonecore.ts Series: shift 0 = the phantom forming bar, 1 = the newest closed bar, larger = older
(MQL index semantics). Pure.

note: generated by scripts/make-arrival-fixtures.ts from supabase/functions/telegram-bot/arrival.ts (canonical). Rules: see the header of arrival.ts (A: zvTrend.zvLines with FitAnchor; B: arrival zones; C: weak / realignment / LTF confirmation). Bars = CLOSED bars, oldest first, [time, o, h, l, c]; shifts: 1 = newest closed bar (bars[-1]), larger = older; price = the live price (arrivalTf: the HTF lines use it as the phantom bar; the TF itself uses its newest close). params: fx = FX_PARAMS (base_strict, emo_touch), stock = RAJA. expected.lines = zvLines on the TF bars (phantom = newest close): shifts a (older anchor, after FitAnchor) / b, prices pa / pb. expected.arrivals = every arrival, newest first (zone.legBar ascending); current = index into it (-1 none); plan / confirm / pending as arrivalTf. Compare numbers with |x - y| <= 1e-9 * max(1, |x|).

cases.name: reanchor
cases.about: wick re-anchoring: a candle between the two real peaks pokes above the line - it becomes the older anchor

cases.name: dem2
cases.about: demand arrival: the leg-out crosses the D1 down line and removes 2 supplies (strong); no HTF

cases.name: nocross
cases.about: no arrival: the leg-out removes supplies but never closes above the down line

cases.name: ceiling
cases.about: demand arrival with the W1 down line still intact above: TP capped below the W1 line

cases.name: extend
cases.about: demand arrival with the W1 down line crossed: TP extends to the W1 supply

cases.name: supply
cases.about: supply arrival at the top of an uptrend: same-TF demands weak, realignment = the demand nearest the W1 up line

cases.name: confirm
cases.about: supply arrival, price inside the realignment demand, a 1H demand arrival there = the confirmed buy

cases.name: pending
cases.about: supply arrival, price inside the realignment demand, no 1H arrival yet = pending

cases.name: SLB_W1
cases.about: published SLB W1 (stock zones >= W1; H4 confirmation not in the shard)

cases.name: CELH_W1
cases.about: published CELH W1 (stock zones >= W1; H4 confirmation not in the shard)
